title: Apple TV to air first major live pro sports event shot on iPhone 17 Pro
summary: On May 23, Apple TV presents a special MLS match captured on iPhone 17 Pro — a first for a major professional live sports event.

title: The App Store stopped over $2.2 billion in fraudulent transactions in 2025
summary: In 2025, Apple prevented over $2.2 billion in potentially fraudulent transactions, adding to a total of more than $11.2 billion in the past six years.

title: Apple Sports expands to more than 90 new countries and regions
summary: Apple Sports is now available in more than 170 countries and regions, including more than 90 new markets.

title: Apple unveils new accessibility features, and updates with Apple Intelligence
summary: Apple announced major accessibility updates powered by Apple Intelligence, including new capabilities for VoiceOver, Magnifier, and Voice Control.

title: Apple kicks off Worldwide Developers Conference on June 8
summary: Apple today unveiled an exciting lineup for its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC), taking place June 8-12.

title: Wackadoo! Join Bluey for the ultimate playdate on Apple Arcade starting May 21
summary: Apple Arcade adds an exclusive Bluey playdate across five hit games, in addition to adding four new titles.

title: End-to-end encrypted RCS messaging begins rolling out today in beta
summary: Apple and Google collaborate with the GSMA to roll out end-to-end encrypted RCS messaging in beta, enhancing cross-platform communication security.

title: How filmmakers are redefining the art form with MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone
summary: Emerging filmmakers in the MAMI Select: Filmed on iPhone program use iPhone 17 Pro Max to redefine cinematic language and storytelling.

title: AI meets accessibility in this year’s Swift Student Challenge
summary: Meet four Swift Student Challenge winners who are creating innovative apps that leverage AI and focus on accessibility.

title: Apple Manufacturing Academy accelerates AI use in U.S. supply chains
summary: Apple’s Manufacturing Academy hosted its inaugural Spring Forum, bringing together U.S. manufacturers to accelerate the use of AI in supply chains.

title: Apple introduces a new Pride Collection
summary: The new Apple Watch Pride Edition Sport Loop, watch face, and iPhone and iPad wallpaper celebrate LGBTQ+ communities during Pride Month and beyond.

title: Apple reports second quarter results
summary: Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2026 second quarter ended March 28, 2026.

title: Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend, streaming live on Apple TV
summary: Formula 1® returns to the U.S. this weekend with the Miami Grand Prix, streaming exclusively on Apple TV with every session available live.

title: Tim Cook to become Apple Executive Chairman John Ternus to become Apple CEO
summary: Apple announced Tim Cook will become executive chairman of Apple’s board of directors and John Ternus will become Apple’s next CEO.

title: Johny Srouji named Apple’s Chief Hardware Officer
summary: Apple today announced that, effective immediately, Apple executive Johny Srouji will become chief hardware officer.

title: Apple accelerates progress with highest-ever recycled material in its products
summary: Apple today announced that a record 30 percent of material across all of its products shipped in 2025 came from recycled content.

title: Apple Arcade brings endless family fun with Nick Jr. Replay! on May 7
summary: This May, Apple Arcade is rolling out the red carpet for some of the world’s most iconic and celebrated characters in its family-friendly lineup of fun games.

title: Apple adds new partners to its American Manufacturing Program
summary: Apple announced new members of its American Manufacturing Program, expanding the company’s commitment to bring more advanced manufacturing to the U.S.

title: Introducing Apple Business — a new all-in-one platform for businesses of all sizes
summary: Apple today announced Apple Business, a new all-in-one platform that allows companies to manage devices and reach more customers.

title: Apple’s Worldwide Developers Conference returns the week of June 8
summary: Apple today announced it will host its annual Worldwide Developers Conference (WWDC) online from June 8-12.
